scope: Read-only source/bundle audit; no browser/visual performance claims, no code/git changes.

versions.note: Exact package.json pins inspected; no claim these are latest releases.

baseline.source: Existing dist/assets captured duringaudit; build may predate concurrent final artwork additions.
baseline.gzipMethod: Python gzip.compress(...,mtime=0); bytes are local artifacts, not production transfer measurements.

mediaMinimalProjection.detail: Read-only estimate retaining src,width,height,title,kind,region and exercise captions; no source changed. Further dedup by shared sheet could reduce metadata.

officialDocumentation.status: All six official pages returnedHTTP200, originalHTML and extracted text saved. Current page content supports API behavior, not release-date claims.

findings.title: Initial JavaScript contains the whole catalog/media manifest and every screen

evidence.detail: Overview, Routines, Library, Workout, Insights, Preferences, Account and Legal imported eagerly.
Catalog, machine catalog and curation imported synchronously; data.js is used by startup storage.

findings.recommendation: First trim/deduplicate runtime media asset metadata while retaining research registry provenance; then lazy-load noninitial screens with React.lazy/Suspense and preserve chunk-error recovery. For further gains split lightweight saved-ID/metric data from rich browsing metadata; routing alone will not remove catalog imports required by startup storage.
findings.risk: Medium: preserve all historical IDs/units, account boundaries, legal access and existing navigation/modal state. Do not drop catalog data needed for schema validation.

findings.title: Small card thumbnails load full-resolution PNG atlases

evidence.detail: 84px compact cards use original asset.src and CSS atlas positioning; lazy loading affects timing but not image payload size.

findings.recommendation: Generate additional small atlas derivatives or per-cell thumbnails and medium guide derivatives in an approved asset-processing workflow, preserve every original unchanged and propagate reviewed bounds/hashes. Native lazy loading and async decoding should remain. Measure actual loaded image bytes under root's browser capture before choosing quality/format thresholds.
findings.risk: Medium: crop geometry and attribution/cache version must stay correct; compression must preserve detailed grips/support.15MB is a potential first24 total, not actual viewport transfer; browser lazy-load thresholds and caching vary.

findings.title: Opening one sourced guide downloads all full instructions

evidence.detail: One cached dynamic import of entire instructions.json; deduplicates requests and clears cached promise on rejection.

findings.recommendation: Keep the existing fallback text, retry semantics and deduplication; partition instructions into a modest number of stable chunks keyed by canonical instruction ID if first-guide latency proves material. Preload on deliberate guide hover/focus only after considering data costs.
findings.risk: Medium: canonical aliases and instructionId must remain exact; avoid generating1414 tiny requests/chunks or changing source attribution.

findings.title: Workout timer rerenders the entire set logger four times per second

evidence.detail: 250ms setNow drives whole Workout component; elapsed/remaining displayed as whole seconds.
Every timer render maps exercise rows and linearly searches catalog using exercises.find.

findings.recommendation: Use exerciseById.get for repeated lookups. Isolate timer display into a narrow component/subscription, or update state only when displayed seconds change while preserving absolute timestamps and rest completion. Profile long workouts before broader memoization.
findings.risk: Low-to-medium: rest expiry, pause/resume, hidden-tab drift, notification exactly-once behavior and existing saved deadlines must remain intact.

findings.title: Every search renormalizes1414 static searchable records

evidence.detail: Joins all searchable fields and applies NFKD/lowercase/regex for every record on each filter call.
Already uses useDeferredValue and memoized filtering with24-card paging; these are useful existing controls.

findings.recommendation: Precompute folded search strings once and return true immediately for empty query; hoist stable equipment/activity option sets. Preserve deferred query and paginated rendering. Treat this as lower priority than payload reduction.
findings.risk: Low: retain matching of aliases, diacritics, all query tokens and equipment tags. Node numbers do not establish browser INP.

findings.title: Large guest histories are fully cloned/validated/serialized for each edit

evidence.detail: Each mutation structuredClones base, validates entire workspace and serializes it to synchronous localStorage.

findings.recommendation: Profile near-limit synthetic workspaces first. If blocking is demonstrated, move durable guest storage to IndexedDB with a tested schema migration and preserve lock/recovery/conflict semantics; retain server validation independently. Avoid casually bypassing validation or debouncing away durable changes.
findings.risk: High implementation risk: user data migration, cross-tab locking and recovery correctness dominate; this is a measured follow-up proposal, not an immediate rewrite.

existingStrengths: Full instructions already dynamically imported with cached-promise retry.
Compact images use native lazy loading, async decoding and reserved CSS aspect ratio; guide imagery eager with readable finite error state.
Library limits initial rendering to24 and uses deferred search.
Saved exerciseById Map and account boundary/error handling already present.
nextValidation: Root to capture cold/warm initial requests and transferred/decoded image bytes at mobile/desktop viewports.
Compare account and guest build routes before/after any split; ensure browser chunk-error recovery.
Profile longWorkout timer commits and near-limit synthetic guest data.
Production image/cache headers must be observed; worker static handler preserves ASSETS headers so no cache defect inferred solely from source.
